#-------------
# Packages
#-------------

```{r, message = FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(tidypaleo)

```

# --------------------------------------------
## (micro)Charcoal Accumulation Rate (CHAR) ##
# --------------------------------------------

# ------- Baiau Superior --------

```{r, CHAR calculation}

# ----------------- Initial dataframes -----------------

# Initial long-format data frame (raw data):
ba_sup_raw_df <- read.csv("Specify your directory/Unified_raw_dataframes/baiau_superior_raw_unified_data_frame.csv", sep = ";")

# Raw CHAR & pollen dataframe:
raw_char_pollen_df <- read.csv("Specify your directory/Pollen_CHAR/raw_char_pollen_df.csv", sep = ";")


# Get age and depth intervals:
ba_depth_age <- ba_sup_raw_df %>%   # One row x sample!
  distinct(
    sample, .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>% 
select(sample, top.depth, bottom.depth, age.interval, density) %>% 
    group_by(sample) %>% 
    mutate(
    depth.interval = bottom.depth - top.depth
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-top.depth, -bottom.depth)

# Combine both data frames by overlapping samples:
raw_char_pollen_df <- raw_char_pollen_df %>% 
  inner_join(ba_depth_age, by = "sample")

# ----------- Compute CHAR -----------

# CHAR = C x MAR = particles/cm2 yr 
## MAR = mass accumulation rate = Density x SAR = g/cm2 yr;
### SAR = sediment accumulation rate = depth interval / age interval = cm/yr
####                                                              (Tracking environmental Change using lake Sediments; Chp.3, Smol et al 2001)

# Compute CHAR, MAR and SAR:
raw_char_all_pollen_df <- raw_char_pollen_df %>% 
  mutate(
    SAR = depth.interval / age.interval,
    MAR = density * SAR,
    CHAR = raw_char_conc * MAR
  )

```

# ---------------------------------
## Pollen, NPPs and CHAR diagram ##
# ---------------------------------

# ------- Baiau Superior --------

```{r, Dataframes & pre-treatment}

# ---------------- Pre-treatment ----------------

# Re-organise the dataframe:
raw_char_all_pollen_df <- raw_char_all_pollen_df %>% 
  mutate(
    Polypodium_other_spores = Polypodium + Other_Spore_T + Spore_M.Dryopteris_Polystichum_Polypodium  # They can be summed 
  ) %>% 
  select(-Coniochaetaceae_Xylariaceae, -Myriophyllum, -Rhamnus, -Urtica, -Helianthemum, -Echium, Brassicaceae, -Vitis, -Salix, -Acer, -Ilex, -Phillyrea, -Polypodium, -Other_Spore_T, -Spore_M.Dryopteris_Polystichum_Polypodium, -Aquatics)  # They are not quite abundant

# ---------------- Taxa in the exact plotting order ----------------

trees_vars <- c("Pinus", "Abies", "Alnus", "Betula", "Corylus", "Fagus", "Fraxinus", "Juniperus", "Quercus_deciduous", "Quercus_evergreen", "Tilia", "Ulmus")

crops_vars <- c("Castanea", "Olea", "Juglans", "Cerealia", "Secale")

shrubs_herbs_vars <- c("Ericaceae", "Ephedra", "Poaceae", "Amaranthaceae", "Apiaceae", "Artemisia", "Asteraceae_Cichorioideae", "Asteraceae_Asteroideae", "Plantago", "Cannabaceae", "Campanula", "Lamiaceae", "Rubiaceae", "Fabaceae", "Caryophyllaceae", "Papaveraceae", "Rumex_acetosella", "Spergularia")

aquatics_vars <- c("Ranunculus", "Potentilla", "Cyperaceae", "Typha_Sparganium_T")

ferns_vars <- c("Polypodium_other_spores")

coprophilous_fungi_vars <- c("Sporormiella", "Cercophora", "Sordaria")

taxon_order <- c(trees_vars, crops_vars, shrubs_herbs_vars, aquatics_vars, ferns_vars, coprophilous_fungi_vars)

# ---------------- Compute pollen influx ----------------

# Extract one row per sample from ba_sup_raw_df:
pollen_influx_metadata <- ba_sup_raw_df %>%
  distinct(sample, mean.age, top.depth, bottom.depth, top.age, bottom.age, age.interval, density, water.cont) %>%   # We need the density, age interval and depth interval
  mutate(
    depth_interval = bottom.depth - top.depth
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean.age)

# Calculate sedimentation rate & dry mass accumulation rate:
pollen_influx_metadata <- pollen_influx_metadata %>%
  mutate(
    sedimentation_rate = depth_interval / age.interval,       # SAR
    dry_mass_accumulation_rate = density * sedimentation_rate   # MAR
  )

# Join the metadata to the pollen data frame:
raw_char_all_pollen_df <- raw_char_all_pollen_df %>%
  left_join(
    pollen_influx_metadata %>%
      select(sample, density, sedimentation_rate, dry_mass_accumulation_rate, depth_interval, age.interval),
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Terrestrial_pollen_flux = Terrestrial_pollen_conc * dry_mass_accumulation_rate
  )

# ---------------- Prepare equally spaced sample positions ordered by age ----------------

# Each sample receives equal vertical spacing:
sample_positions <- raw_char_all_pollen_df %>%
  distinct(sample, mean.age) %>%
  arrange(mean.age) %>%
  mutate(
    y_index = row_number()
  )

# Join the positions to the full data frame: 
plot_source_df <- raw_char_all_pollen_df %>%
  left_join(sample_positions, by = c("sample", "mean.age")) %>%
  arrange(y_index)

# ---------------- Prepare the taxon data ----------------

# This prevents alphabetical facet ordering:
taxa_long <- plot_source_df %>%
  select(sample, mean.age, y_index, all_of(taxon_order)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(taxon_order),
    names_to = "Taxon",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = case_when(
      Taxon %in% trees_vars ~ "Trees",
      Taxon %in% crops_vars ~ "Crops",
      Taxon %in% shrubs_herbs_vars ~ "Shrubs and herbs",
      Taxon %in% aquatics_vars ~ "Aquatics",
      Taxon %in% ferns_vars ~ "Ferns",
      Taxon %in% coprophilous_fungi_vars ~ "Coprophilous fungi",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    Category = factor(
      Category,
      levels = c(
        "Trees",
        "Crops",
        "Shrubs and herbs",
        "Aquatics",
        "Ferns",
        "Coprophilous fungi"
      )
    ),

    Taxon = factor(
      Taxon,
      levels = taxon_order
    )
  )

# ---------------- Create cleaner visible labels & category colours ----------------

taxon_labels <- setNames(str_replace_all(taxon_order, "_", " "), taxon_order)

# Override the longest and less readable names:
taxon_labels["Quercus_deciduous"] <-"Quercus deciduous"
taxon_labels["Quercus_evergreen"] <- "Quercus evergreen"
taxon_labels["Asteraceae_Cichorioideae"] <- "Asteraceae Cichorioideae"
taxon_labels["Asteraceae_Asteroideae"] <- "Asteraceae Asteroideae"
taxon_labels["Rumex_acetosella"] <- "Rumex acetosella"
taxon_labels["Typha_Sparganium_T"] <- "Typha/Sparganium"
taxon_labels["Polypodium_other_spores"] <- "Polypodium and other spores"

# Define the category colours:
category_colours <- c(
  "Trees" = "#2E7D32",
  "Crops" = "#C70B0B",
  "Shrubs and herbs" = "#D08C24",
  "Aquatics" = "#3182BD",
  "Ferns" = "#9005A4",
  "Coprophilous fungi" = "#795548"
)

summary_colours <- c(
  "Arboreal" = category_colours[["Trees"]],
  "Non-arboreal" = category_colours[["Shrubs and herbs"]]
)

# ---------------- Define the age-axis labels once ----------------

# Show values every 1000 years:
age_values_to_show <- seq(from = 1000, to = 7000, by = 1000)

# Show specific age values:
age_values_to_show <- c(1000, 2000, 4000, 5000, 6000, 7000)

# Convert those ages into positions along the equally spaced sampled axis:
age_tick_df <- tibble(
  age = age_values_to_show,
  y_position = approx(
    x = sample_positions$mean.age,
    y = sample_positions$y_index,
    xout = age_values_to_show,
    ties = "ordered"
  )$y
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(y_position))

# Define:
age_breaks <- age_tick_df$y_position
age_labels <- scales::comma(age_tick_df$age)

# ---------------- Customise the number of x-axis values ----------------

# Display only 0 and maximum values (just in case):
zero_max_breaks <- function(x) {

  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  c(
    0,
    max(x)
  )
}
 
# Hide zero values to prevent overlapping:
hide_zero_labels <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    abs(x) < .Machine$double.eps^0.5,
    "",
    scales::label_number(
      accuracy = 0.1,
      trim = TRUE
    )(x)
  )
}

scale_x_continuous(
  breaks = zero_max_breaks,
  labels = hide_zero_labels,
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------
#  Stacked arboreal/non-arboreal panel
# -----------------------------------------------------------------

# Prepare the data for plotting:
summary_df <- plot_source_df %>%
  transmute(
    sample,
    mean.age,
    y_index,
    Arboreal,
    Non_arboreal,
    Total_pollen = Arboreal + Non_arboreal
  )

# Plot the summary pollen chart:
p_summary <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(y = y_index)) +

  # Complete pollen sum, shown in the non-arboreal colour
  geom_areah(
    aes(
      x = Total_pollen,
      fill = "Non-arboreal"
    ),
    alpha = 0.65,
    size = 0.25,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  # Arboreal component overlaid from zero to Arboreal
  geom_areah(
    aes(
      x = Arboreal,
      fill = "Arboreal"
    ),
    alpha = 0.85,
    size = 0.25,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = summary_colours,
    breaks = c(
      "Arboreal",
      "Non-arboreal"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = c(0, 50, 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +

  scale_y_reverse(
    breaks = age_breaks,
    labels = age_labels,
    expand = expansion(add = 0.5)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Age (cal yr BP)",
    title = "Arboreal / Non-arboreal"
  ) +

  theme_paleo() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0, hjust = 0, size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

p_summary

# --------------------------------------------------------------
#  Taxon plot - Root-square of each taxon's max. abund
# --------------------------------------------------------------

# Calculate the width assigned to each taxon:
taxon_widths <- taxa_long %>%
  group_by(Taxon) %>%
  summarise(
    max_abundance = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Taxon = factor(Taxon, levels = taxon_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Taxon) %>%
  mutate(
    width = sqrt(max_abundance)
  )

taxon_widths

# One plot per taxon:
taxon_plots <- lapply(taxon_order, function(tx) {

  taxon_dat <- taxa_long %>%
    filter(Taxon == tx)

  ggplot(
    taxon_dat,
    aes(
      x = Value,
      y = y_index,
      fill = Category,
      colour = Category
    )
  ) +

    geom_areah(
      alpha = 0.65,
      size = 0.25,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      show.legend = tx == taxon_order[1]
    ) +

    geom_areah_exaggerate(
      exaggerate_x = 3,
      alpha = 0.22,
      size = 0.25,
      #linetype = "dashed",
      na.rm = TRUE,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    
    facet_wrap(
      vars(Taxon),
      labeller = as_labeller(taxon_labels)
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = category_colours,
      breaks = names(category_colours),
      limits = names(category_colours),
      name = NULL,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_colour_manual(
      values = category_colours,
      name = NULL,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = zero_max_breaks,
      labels = hide_zero_labels,
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(0, 0.08)
      )
    ) +

    scale_y_reverse(
      breaks = age_breaks,
      labels = rep("", length(age_breaks)),
      expand = expansion(add = 0.5)
    ) +

    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +

    guides(
      colour = "none",
      fill = guide_legend(
        nrow = 1,
        byrow = TRUE,
        override.aes = list(alpha = 0.8)
      )
    ) +

    theme_paleo() +

    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, size = 8, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 3, b = 2)),
      strip.clip = "off",
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 2, b = 4, l = 2))
})

# Combine them with their calculated widths:
p_taxa <- wrap_plots(
  taxon_plots,
  nrow = 1,
  widths = taxon_widths$width,
  guides = "collect"
) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "center"
  )

p_taxa

# -----------------------------------
#  Pollen influx 
# -----------------------------------

# Data for plotting:
pollen_flux_df <- plot_source_df %>%
  transmute(
    sample,
    mean.age,
    y_index,
    Value = Terrestrial_pollen_flux
  )

# Plot:
p_pollen_flux <- ggplot(pollen_flux_df, aes(x = Value, y = y_index)) +
  geom_areah(
    fill = "grey25",
    colour = "black",
    alpha = 0.65,
    size = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(
      scale_cut = cut_short_scale()
    ),
    breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 3),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse(
    breaks = age_breaks,
    labels = rep("", length(age_breaks)),
    expand = expansion(add = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title = expression(
      paste(
        "Terrestrial pollen influx (pollen ",
        cm^{-2},
        " ",
        yr^{-1},
        ")"
      ))
  ) +
  
  theme_paleo() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0, hjust = 0, size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

p_pollen_flux

# -----------------------------------------------------------------
#  CHAR panel
# -----------------------------------------------------------------

# Data for plotting:
char_df <- plot_source_df %>%
  transmute(
    sample,
    mean.age,
    y_index,
    Value = CHAR
  )

# Plot:
p_char <- ggplot(char_df, aes(x = Value, y = y_index)) +

  geom_colh(
    width = 0.7,
    fill = "grey25",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 3),
    labels = label_number(
      accuracy = 1,
      trim = TRUE
    ),
    guide = guide_axis(
      check.overlap = TRUE
    ),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0.05)
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_reverse(
    breaks = age_breaks,
    labels = rep("", length(age_breaks)),
    expand = expansion(add = 0.5)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title = expression(
      paste(
        "CHAR (particles ",
        cm^{-2},
      " ",
      yr^{-1},
      ")"
      ))
  ) +

  theme_paleo() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0, hjust = 0, size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

p_char

# -----------------------------------------------------------------
#  Combined plot
# -----------------------------------------------------------------

# Final composition with terrestrial pollen influx:
final_pollen_char_plot <-p_summary + p_taxa + p_pollen_flux + p_char +
  plot_layout(
    nrow = 1,
    widths = c(2.5, length(taxon_order), 2.2, 2.2),
    guides = "collect"
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Baiau Superior",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 20,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0
      )
    )
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

final_pollen_char_plot

```
